Routing only -- this is not a diagnosis, and the response is worded for a

Which triage provider is live. The rule engine is always available, so
this reports degraded rather than unhealthy when Claude is not configured.

Join a queue. The server picks the best doctor and hospital from the

priority first, then arrival.

get.description:
Redirect to a short-lived presigned URL.

The object key is never exposed -- the link authorises itself and expires,
because it will end up in browser history.

schema.title: Response List Consents Api Patients Me Consents Get

get.description:
Identity and demographics, plus the sensitive fields the patient chose
to share. Returned bare -- the page reads this object directly.

What the patient has shared. The chart uses this to decide which tabs to
show; the server still re-checks each one.
Autocomplete for the Rx pad. Defined in the client but never wired up.

schema.title: Response Search Medicines Api Consultation Medicines Search Get

post.description:
Write a prescription from the consultation.

Writing is not a consent-gated read -- a doctor treating a patient may
always prescribe -- but the consultation must be live and theirs.

StreamTokenResponse.title: StreamTokenResponse
StreamTokenResponse.description:
EventSource cannot set headers, so the SSE token rides in the query
string. Kept short-lived because a query string leaks into logs.
